A thick white line climbs upward in square steps like a staircase from the lower left toward the upper right, led by a small solid electric blue (#1849F7) dot that hops from step to step with snappy squash-and-stretch. The upper-middle third of the frame stays empty for a logo added later. Motion starts on the very first frame and keeps constant energy to the last frame. Same line weight and palette throughout.
Audio: complete silence. No dialogue, no voice, no music, no sound effects, no ambience.
Avoid: on-screen text, subtitles, letters, watermark, scene cut, camera shake, morphing, style change, 3D shading, photorealism, extra characters, background change, color shift, blur.
